what: the old-layout folders of the private store that this repository names (in its tools, records and notes) and the folder each one's files stand under in the store's v2/ layout, read from the corpus lane's plan of the restructure. The site reads none of these at run time; they are where a record came from. A name in the repository is not rewritten for this: the record a tool or a zone wrote stays as written, and this file says where the same bytes stand now.
how: every row of the plan whose source is r2:mishkan/<folder>/…, grouped by the v2 folder its file went under (the v2 path less the part of the path the file keeps); a folder's letters went to v2/letters/<folder> and its work to the first path given
standing: the old layout still stands on the store (nothing is deleted until the proofs pass and the owner says go); when it goes, this is the map
